A shared language for home data.
Obiekt nadaje informacjom punkt odniesie: An object gives information a point of reference. Instead of separate silos for a car, person and device, the model can represent the relationships between them.
Obiekt reprezentuje osobę, pojazd, miesz: An object represents a person, vehicle, home, room, device, pet, service or organisation. Fields describe its attributes and tags help organise the collection.
Toyota Corolla może mieć właściciela będ: A Toyota Corolla can have an owner represented by a separate object. The policy, invoices and manual refer to the same vehicle while retaining their own document identities.
Data końca ubezpieczenia ma znaczenie w: An insurance expiry date makes sense in the context of a vehicle. Deadlines and change history stay with the object, rather than getting lost in file names.
DocumentProvider oddziela kontekst od pl: DocumentProvider separates context from the file.
Core nie musi przejmować zadań systemu d: Core does not need to take over document management. DocumentProvider is the boundary through which HomeOS uses Paperless-ngx. Relationships to people and devices remain part of the home model.
Oddzielne bazy PostgreSQL podkreślają te: Separate PostgreSQL databases reinforce this boundary. Valkey / BullMQ handles background work, while Docker Compose brings the services together in a homelab on your own home server.
Plan infrastruktury sieci domowej HomeOS: HomeOS home network plan: MikroTik CRS310-8G+2S+IN, RJ45 cabling, an SFP+ server link and a separate concept for network segmentation.
Fizyczne połączenia odpowiadają na pytan: Physical connections answer what connects where. Logical segmentation describes device roles. They are two separate views of the same network.
Główny switch MikroTik CRS310-8G+2S+IN ł: The main MikroTik CRS310-8G+2S+IN switch connects the router to room cabling. The office houses the computer, HomeOS server and room for expansion.
To plan okablowania, nie potwierdzenie w: This is a cabling plan, not confirmation of an installed network. The spare living room port and optional office switch are reserved for future use.
Docelowe zakończenia okablowania w pomie: Planned cable terminations in each room
Plan obejmuje osiem zakończeń RJ45 w pom: The plan includes eight RJ45 room terminations and an SFP+ server link. The router-to-switch connection needs a separate port assignment. Port numbers, modules and the uplink medium have not been specified in this concept.
Poniższe segmenty porządkują koncepcję s: These segments organise the network concept. They do not represent a completed VLAN configuration or an implemented access policy.
Identyfikatory VLAN, podsieci i reguły f: VLAN IDs, subnets and firewall rules have not been specified. Segmentation alone does not define permitted traffic between segments.
Serwer blisko danych: A server close to the data
HomeOS is designed to run on the LAN. The CRS310 → SFP+ → HomeOS Server link highlights the path to services and local data, without claiming unmeasured throughput.
Zdalny dostęp jest kontrolowaną, opcjona: Remote access is a controlled, optional layer. The access method and security rules remain part of the deployment configuration.

Zarządzanie dokumentami domowymi wymaga: Managing household documents takes more than a folder of PDFs. HomeOS is designed to connect a document's contents to the person or thing it concerns.
Skan otrzymuje nazwę, typ, powiązanie z: A scan gets a name, a type, a vehicle relationship and an expiry date. Together, these details provide useful context.

Warstwa dokumentowa porządkuje pliki. OC: The document layer organises files. OCR makes the text searchable, including when the source is a scan.
Dokument zostaje powiązany z obiektem pr: The document is connected to an object through DocumentProvider. The policy refers to a vehicle, and the vehicle has a relationship with its owner.
Core przechowuje swój model i relacje. P: Core stores its model and relationships. Paperless-ngx has a separate database for documents. The document and object do not have to be a single record to stay connected.
Wyszukiwanie pomaga odnaleźć treść. Powi: Search helps find the contents. Relationships lead to the right object. An accurately recorded deadline can provide the basis for a reminder.
Odczytanie daty ze skanu nie oznacza jes: Reading a date from a scan does not establish that it is an insurance expiry date. The document type, object and deadline need accurate descriptions. The project does not assume every PDF can be interpreted automatically without errors.
Self-hosted document management pozwala: Self-hosted document management keeps files on your own server. HomeOS adds a model of the home: people, devices and relationships that give documents meaning.
